issues.title: Fix Rat King's camera: set citadel_camera_use_vmdl_flatten_vertical to true
issues.body:
Fixes #70.

With `citadel_camera_use_vmdl_flatten_vertical "false"`, Rat King's camera (which uses VMDL camera poses) sits in the ground. Setting it back to its default `true` fixes it, as confirmed in #70 and by testing in game.

Changes:
- `Sqooky's .gi/gameinfo.gi`, `Sqooky's .gi/base_convars.txt`, `test_cfg/gameinfo.gi`, and both `kaizuchanerus minimum spec` gameinfos: `false` → `true`.
- README FAQ: a Rat King entry next to the existing Rem/Venator one.

Trade-off: the README notes that `false` was meant to keep Rem's and Venator's aim-down-sights camera steady. With `true`, their camera moves down slightly when aiming, but every hero is playable.

issues.title: Fix missing projectile and grenade contact explosion effects in Boot config
issues.body:
### Problem
In **Boot's Max FPS config**, projectile and grenade contact explosions (such as Yamato's alternate fire right-click burst) do not render contact explosion effects upon impacting surfaces or enemies.

### Root Cause
Several cvars in Boot's config aggressively suppress impact and particle rendering:
1. `cl_impacteffects "0"` and `citadel_per_weapon_per_surface_impact_effects "false"`: Suppressed all surface impact effects.
2. `particle_cluster_nodraw "1"` and `particle_cluster_use_collision_hulls "false"`: Skipped drawing particle clusters and disabled collision hulls for clusters.
3. `r_particle_max_detail_level "0"`: Culled ability and explosion particles that require detail level >= 1 (Spooky's config already sets this to `"1"`).
4. `cl_phys_enabled "false"`: Disabled client-side physics simulation, preventing projectile collision/contact events from properly dispatching on the client.
5. `r_particle_allowprerender "false"`: Skipped pre-rendering required for instant single-frame explosion bursts.
6. `cl_particle_sim_fallback_threshold_ms "0"` and aggressive multipliers: Immediately forced spawned particle systems into degraded/empty fallbacks.

### Solution
- Re-enabled `citadel_per_weapon_per_surface_impact_effects "true"` and `cl_impacteffects "1"`.
- Reset `particle_cluster_nodraw "0"` and `particle_cluster_use_collision_hulls "true"`.
- Set `r_particle_max_detail_level "1"` (matching Spooky's config).
- Set `cl_phys_enabled "true"` and `r_particle_allowprerender "true"`.
- Commented out the `0ms` fallback simulation thresholds.

### Verification
Tested in-game: Yamato's right-click burst now properly renders its contact explosion effect on surfaces and targets, while maintaining all other FPS optimizations (shadows, lighting, cloth, models, audio, HUD).

issues.title: style: formatted with vdf-fmt
issues.body:
`vdf-fmt` is getting ready for a public release. it is written in rust.

- remove erroneous whitespaces
- normalize grouped key/value pair spacing
- justify comments
- normalize indentation
- remove quotes when possible on key names
- reflow commented out key/value pairs too; require single space after comment
- force quotes on all values (yeah I went back to this on that because it makes it easier to edit if you know where the value "starts")

let me know if any of these formatting choices should be changed.

issues.title: Causing a crash on linux
issues.body:
Recently been experiencing a lot of crashes especially right when a match is found, when using this config on linux,
first I thought it was an issue with NTsync or a file limit issue on linux which I discovered on protonDB, I tried both fixing the limit and disabling NTsync which may have helped some but it was still crashing a lot, turns out it's something in the config itself.
I also noticed that steam tries to verify game files automatically right after the crash, so it just overwrites the config with the original gameinfo.gi again. So I'm guessing the game doesn't like something about the config that triggers both a crash and verification. Strange because I have gotten it to run sometimes with the config, it just crashes way too much. In the meantime it is working fine without it. Hopefully you can look into this as the config does help fps a lot! Thanks!
